prompts.A:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: production clean plate for a cinematic webpage object-lift transition.
Edit target: the supplied original portrait film frame. Edit this single image, preserving its exact framing and camera perspective.
Primary request: remove ONLY the entire brass compass, including its round metal body, needle, compass face, four-leaf ornament, suspension neck, upper brass ring, every piece of metal, and the complete shadow cast by that compass and ring. Reconstruct a continuous original ivory parchment page in the removed region, naturally extending the original subtle parchment grain, pale stains and botanical/map-page artwork wherever it would continue beneath the object.
Invariants: retain the original exact portrait composition, page perspective, page edges, original dark forest-green gilt paper corners at upper right and lower left, every visible botanical/clover motif and line decoration outside the removed compass-and-shadow area, the existing warm illumination and natural aged paper texture. Do not crop, rotate, reframe, move or redesign the surrounding original page. Keep the result visually registered to the input frame so it can replace the frame after the compass is lifted.
The center is now uninterrupted flat ivory parchment, with no circular outline, no object-shaped scar, no depression, no compass ghost or residual ring shadow.
Output: one high-resolution portrait 9:16 raster image, ideally 2160 × 3840 pixels.
Avoid: any compass, any ring, any new objects, any holes, tears or portals, landscape glimpses, new text, letters, logos, branding, watermark, UI. Do not invent a new page design.
prompts.B:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: production hidden-world landscape texture for a cinematic reveal underneath an ivory parchment webpage.
Primary request: create a full-bleed portrait 3:4 image of an intimate miniature forest gorge seen from a top-oblique macro camera looking down into it. The entire image is landscape texture from edge to edge. The gorge should feel alive and tactile, like a real very small natural world photographed with handcrafted cinematic realism, matching warm parchment-era brass-compass imagery in material richness and light.
Composition: NO horizon. View down into deeply layered irregular limestone formations and moss-covered forest banks from an elevated oblique viewpoint. A clear teal stream enters from the upper-right through a narrow mossy rock cleft and small waterfall around 65% across and 25% down the image, winds through the center and descends toward the lower-left into a clear pool. Place a second smaller secluded clear pool on the far right, visible between irregular rocks and foliage, inviting exploration. Keep the main winding river spatially readable and continuous, with detailed clear water zones suitable for subtle localized refraction. Strong visible depth between canopy, gorge walls, ledges and water, but an intimate scale rather than an epic vista.
Lighting and palette: warm natural sunlight from the upper-left, rich forest greens, soft golden light on irregular pale limestone, natural shadow in the cleft, restrained turquoise/teal clear water with visible pebbles and rock detail beneath the shallows. Realistic fine foliage, ferns, moss and small trees with convincing natural structure and scale.
Rendering: exceptionally detailed cinematic photorealism, textured organic surfaces, believable water clarity, natural irregular forms, no toy or plastic appearance.
Output: one high-resolution portrait 3:4 raster image, ideally 1536 × 2048 pixels.
Strict constraints: fill the whole image with forest gorge landscape. No paper rim, no parchment, no oval vignette, no circular border, no mask, no compass, no hand or person, no text, no logos or branding, no UI, no doors or portals, no horizon, no epic mountains, no neon, no magical particles.

processing: Proportional downsample and WebP encoding only. Existing logo, favicon, film, and compass case unchanged.

rim.processing: Neutral baked-grid removal with chroma alpha; center-connected transparent aperture flood fill and 4px dilation; proportional optimization.
rim.prompt: Create ONE production compositing sprite, no storyboard. An irregular oval RIM made of torn warm ivory parchment, on a genuinely transparent background. The central opening is FULLY TRANSPARENT, and the area OUTSIDE the rim is fully transparent too. Portrait 3:4. It is a hole cut through a sheet of old illustrated paper, viewed almost straight down. Thin ragged paper fibers, natural layer thickness, 3 or 4 small curling raised flaps along the upper-left and lower-right sides. Warm sunlight from upper-left, realistic inner shadows delicately baked into the narrow semi-transparent edge. Match the cream parchment in the attached approved storyboard. The oval interior occupies x15–85%, y12–88% of the image, rim only about 5–10% of image width. This is NOT a cardboard frame: delicate ripped paper with curled flaps and visible fibrous underside. Needs readable physical depth at only 300px rendered width. NO COMPASS, NO HAND, NO VALLEY, NO LANDSCAPE, NO TEXT, NO SYMBOLS, NO LOGO, NO WHITE BACKGROUND, NO WHITE-FILLED CENTER, NO UNBROKEN SHEET. Photorealistic macro material, subtle old paper tonality. Output just isolated paper rim with true alpha.
